Residential & Commercial Pest Control

Pests we treat, every day

From a single ant trail to a full termite inspection, we treat the pests that show up around El Dorado County homes and businesses — and regular service keeps them from coming back.

Termites & Wood-Destroying Pests

Comprehensive Wood Destroying Organism inspections and treatment for subterranean, drywood and dampwood termites — plus wood boring beetles, carpenter ants and carpenter bees.

Inspections · Treatment

Ants

Ant trails in the kitchen, carpenter ants in the woodwork — we find where they are coming in and treat the colony, not just the ants you can see.

Interior & Exterior

Spiders

From house spiders to black widows around the property, we clear webs and egg sacs and treat the areas spiders keep coming back to.

Webs · Egg Sacs

Yellow Jackets, Wasps & Hornets

Stinging insects nesting in eaves, trees and wall voids. We remove nests and treat the area so the colony does not rebuild in the same spot.

Nest Removal

Rodents

Rats and mice in the attic, garage or crawl space. We remove the critters, find how they got in, and help keep them out for good.

Removal & Exclusion

Cockroaches & More

Cockroaches, fleas, ticks, earwigs and silverfish — the small pests that spread fast if they are left alone. Treated thoroughly, inside and out.

Termite Service

Wood Destroying Organism inspections

Buying, selling, refinancing — or just wanting peace of mind? Our comprehensive WDO inspection report covers your home, inside and out.

  • Dryrot & fungus — damage identified before it spreads
  • Subterranean, drywood & dampwood termites
  • Wood boring beetles, carpenter ants & carpenter bees
  • Conditions that can lead to dryrot and wood-destroying pests
  • Inaccessible areas noted clearly in your report

How It Works

Simple, from first call to pest-free

No confusing packages, no pushy sales pitch. Here is how getting rid of pests works with us.

01

Call for a free quote

Call (530) 677-7923 or email us. Tell us what you are seeing — we will give you an honest estimate.

02

Inspection

We look over your home or business, find where pests are getting in, and identify exactly what you are dealing with.

03

Treatment

Targeted treatment for the pests found — plus a full WDO report when termites are part of the picture.

04

Regular service

Maintaining regular pest control keeps bugs and critters from coming back after treatment. That is the whole point.
